note: Files that change only with the owner's signed approval (npm run approve -- protected). The list is read from the base branch, so a branch can't shrink its own. Goldens are not here: a behaviour change re-records them with a Golden-Reason trailer, and the scenarios' expected outcomes (qa.mjs), which are, keep a re-recorded loss from passing as a win. A new file under addOnly (a new regression replay) needs no approval; editing or deleting one does. 2.58.0 (PU-35): the game's own check settings (studio/game.json, which game the gates test, and each game's studio.gates.json, which checks it runs and whether they are required) are protected too. 2.58.2 (PU-29): the git hooks and the two checks that read what they leave (commits that skipped the hooks, weakened tests) are protected, so a branch can't switch them off by editing them. 2.62.0: the replay bench (studio/bench/: its cases and graders) is protected, so an agent can't change what measures it. 2.64.0: which sources may route work (studio/triggers.json) is protected, so an agent can't open a trigger source. The autonomy level (studio/autonomy.json) is not: the owner's rule is that a person, a Producer or Director session or an agent outside the harness may change it (workers never: they can't edit studio/ from a lane). 2.67.0: the owner's standing delegation to an outside agent (studio/delegation.json, npm run delegate) is protected, so an agent can't grant itself one. 2.71.0: the studio policy (studio/policy.json, npm run policy: autonomous mode and the owner's rules) is protected, so an agent can't turn autonomous mode on for itself. 2.71.1: the gate runners and what they load (scripts/run-gates.mjs, harness/game-gates.mjs, the cartridge loader, qa/check-*.mjs, the selftests…), so a lane can't neuter the check that judges it; and each game's test toolchain (vitest/vite/jest configs, .npmrc; the setup files those configs name and the test scripts in the game's package.json are added by the harness from the base, harness/test-toolchain.mjs), so a lane can't change what the tests run. 2.72.0: the purity ratchet (harness/ratchet.mjs), which decides which hits stand.
